'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Jack Koswicki LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jack Koswicki]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
